title: Senior Integration Engineer – Pharmacovigilance Systems
description:
**The role**

Connect our in-house systems (including AI-assisted platforms) to each other and to the platforms our clients run: safety databases (Argus, ArisG/LSMV, Veeva Vault Safety), document and content systems (Documentum, Veeva Vault, eTMF), QMS, EDC/CTMS, regulatory and literature platforms, and others as they arise. You personally design, build, troubleshoot and validate the interfaces, and you define how we integrate.

**What you’ll do**

* Own integrations end to end mapping → build → test → validate → deploy → support.
* Write source-to-target mappings, transformation rules and reconciliation logic.
* Build reconciliation, acknowledgement, retry/replay and duplicate-prevention controls so completeness can be proven.
* Decide API vs file/database interfaces, when middleware is justified, and how vendor upgrades affect interfaces.
* Work in client- and vendor-controlled environments (restricted APIs, firewalls, credentials you don’t own).
* Produce GxP/CSV validation evidence.

**Must have**

* Hands-on integration engineering, ideally life sciences.
* Integrated multiple regulated life-sciences platforms (safety databases, document/content systems, QMS, EDC/CTMS, eTMF, regulatory systems), not a single system.
* APIs, XML/JSON, SQL, file interfaces, with real troubleshooting.
* Delivered interfaces in a GxP/CSV environment with validation evidence.
* Can own an interface from design through production.

**Preferred:**
Argus, ArisG/LSMV, Veeva Vault (Safety / QualityDocs / eTMF), Documentum, OpenText, TrackWise, EDC/CTMS platforms, E2B R2/R3, middleware/iPaaS (MuleSoft, Boomi), Oracle/PLSQL, AWS, HL7/FHIR, integrating AI-assisted apps into validated platforms.

title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
YES MADAMJob Description – Data Engineering & Analytics Lead

**Location:**
Sector 63, Noida

**Experience:**
8–12+ Years

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Work Mode:**
Work From Office (WFO)

**Function:**
Data Engineering, Analytics & Business Intelligence

About YES MADAM

YES MADAM is a leading D2C at-home beauty and wellness services platform, serving lakhs of customers across the country. We are a fast-moving, insight-driven organization focused on building scalable technology and delivering exceptional customer experiences.

About the Role

We are looking for a
**Data Engineering & Analytics Lead**
to build and lead our data engineering and analytics capabilities. This role will be responsible for designing scalable data pipelines, developing a reliable data platform, establishing data quality standards, and enabling actionable insights across Product, Technology, Marketing, Operations, Finance, and Business teams.

The ideal candidate will combine strong hands-on data engineering expertise with analytical thinking and leadership capabilities. They should be able to translate business and product requirements into robust data solutions that support product optimization, customer insights, operational efficiency, and business growth.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Data Engineering & Architecture**

* Design and develop scalable, reliable, and cost-efficient data architectures and data pipelines.
* Build and maintain ETL/ELT workflows to ingest, transform, validate, and process data from multiple sources.
* Develop and optimize data warehouses, data lakes, and analytical data models.
* Establish data architecture standards to support growing data volumes and real-time business requirements.
* Ensure data availability, consistency, accuracy, and reliability across systems.

**2. Product & Business Analytics**

* Partner with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Business teams to identify analytical requirements and build data-driven solutions.
* Develop frameworks to track product metrics, customer behaviour, user journeys, conversion funnels, retention, repeat purchases, and cohort performance.
* Enable A/B testing, experimentation, feature performance analysis, and product decision-making.
* Build analytical models to identify business opportunities, customer trends, operational bottlenecks, and growth drivers.
* Translate complex datasets into actionable insights and recommendations for leadership.

**3. Business Intelligence & Reporting**

* Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and self-service analytics capabilities.
* Define and standardize KPIs across product, customer experience, marketing, and operations.
* Enable leadership teams to monitor business performance through reliable and timely reporting.
* Improve reporting accuracy, reduce manual reporting efforts, and establish a single source of truth for key business metrics.

**4. Data Quality, Governance & Security**

* Establish data quality checks, monitoring mechanisms, and pipeline observability.
* Define data governance practices, documentation standards, data lineage, and access controls.
* Ensure appropriate handling of customer and business data in accordance with applicable privacy and security requirements.
* Identify and resolve data discrepancies, pipeline failures, and performance bottlenecks.

**5. Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management**

* Lead, mentor, and develop data engineers and analytics professionals.
* Work closely with Product Managers, Engineering Leaders, Business Heads, and senior leadership.
* Prioritize data initiatives based on business impact, technical feasibility, and organizational needs.
* Drive a culture of data ownership, analytical rigor, and continuous improvement.

Must-Have Skills & Experience

* 8–12+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, business intelligence, or related data-focused roles.
* Strong hands-on expertise in
  **SQL, Python, data modelling, and ETL/ELT pipeline development**
  .
* Experience designing scalable data pipelines and modern data warehouse architectures.
* Strong understanding of data warehouses, data lakes, dimensional modelling, and analytical data models.
* Experience with cloud data platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Hands-on experience with technologies such as Apache Spark, Airflow, dbt, Kafka, or equivalent tools relevant to the organization's architecture.
* Experience with BI and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of product analytics, funnel analysis, cohort analysis, retention, experimentation, and business KPI frameworks.
* Experience leading projects and collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders.
* Strong problem-solving, communication, and people-management skills.

Good-to-Have Skills

* Experience in a product-based organization, consumer internet, D2C, e-commerce, marketplace, or high-growth startup.
* Exposure to product analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, or Firebase Analytics.
* Experience with real-time data processing, streaming architectures, and event-driven systems.
* Knowledge of data orchestration, CI/CD for data pipelines, data observability, and automated data testing.
* Experience with customer segmentation, personalization, recommendation systems, or predictive analytics.
* Exposure to AI/ML data pipelines, feature engineering, and data infrastructure for AI applications.
* Experience building a data platform or analytics function from the ground up.

Key Success Metrics

* Reliability, performance, and scalability of data pipelines.
* Data accuracy, quality, freshness, and availability.
* Reduction in manual reporting and time required to generate insights.
* Adoption and effectiveness of dashboards and analytics solutions.
* Improved visibility into product, customer, and business KPIs.
* Ability to translate business problems into actionable data insights.
* Team productivity, stakeholder satisfaction, and timely delivery of data initiatives.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a hands-on data leader who can build robust data infrastructure while enabling meaningful product and business insights. They should be comfortable working in a fast-paced product environment, balancing technical execution with strategic thinking, and building data capabilities that directly support business growth and product decisions.

title: Senior AI & Decision Science Engineer
description:

**Full-Stack AI & Automation Engineer**
**Human Resources - Strategic Planning & Analytics CoE**

* Candidate should possess “Can-do” attitude, with an ability to thrive in an unstructured environment
* 9 to 12 years of software engineering/automation experience (with at least 2–3 years focused on building AI agents/bots from scratch).
* Masters/ PhD in Computer Science, Information Technology equivalent

* Excellent English, quantitative, technical, and storytelling skills

title: MLOps Engineer
description:
Embark on a transformative journey as ML Operations Engineer at Barclays, where you will play a pivotal role to manage operations within a business area and maintain processes with risk management initiatives. You will take ownership of your work and provide first-class support to our clients with expertise and care.
  
  
**Purpose Of The Role**
To design, implement, and maintain robust MLOps frameworks that streamline the deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management of AI and Generative AI models, ensuring efficient and reliable production operations on AWS.
  
  
**Responsibilities Of The Role**

* Build and optimize scalable, secure, and cost-effective AWS-based infrastructure for ML/GenAI workloads
* Develop automated workflows for data ingestion, model training, testing, deployment, and monitoring using tools like AWS SageMaker, Step Functions, and Lambda
* Implement data quality checks, lineage tracking, and compliance standards for curated datasets
* Integrate ML pipelines with DevOps practices, ensuring seamless collaboration between data science and engineering teams
* Deploy monitoring solutions for model performance, drift detection, and system health using AWS CloudWatch and custom dashboards
* Ensure adherence to security best practices and governance requirements for AI deployments
* Work closely with Data Scientists to operationalize models and optimize deployment strategies

**Technical Skills Required For This Role Include**

* Experience in Programming & Automation: Python, Bash, SQL.
* Worked in MLOps Tools: MLflow, Kubeflow, AWS SageMaker Pipelines.
* Cloud Platforms: AWS (SageMaker, Bedrock, Lambda, Step Functions, CloudWatch)
* DevOps: CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins), Docker, Kubernetes
* Data Management: Data curation, governance, and ETL processes.

The ML Ops Engineer role focuses on building and managing automated pipelines, AWS-based architectures, and monitoring frameworks to enable efficient deployment and lifecycle management of AI and Generative AI models in production environments.
  
  
This role requires a flexible working approach, ensuring availability during select hours that overlap with US-based partners and stakeholders.
  
  
You may be assessed on key essential skills relevant to succeed in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

Some functionality must be rebuilt, redesigned, retained, or handled through an integration or alternative solution. Candidates must explain product boundaries, assess feature and use-case fit, surface gaps early, and set realistic customer expectations. In AJO, a migrated use case lands on AJO Journeys (profile-centric, event-driven orchestration on AEP Real-Time Customer Profile) or AJO Orchestrated Campaigns (campaign-centric, batch, multi-step workflows on the AEP relational data store). Candidates must design and build on both, and recommend the right path per use case.
  
  
What you’ll be doing
  
  
- Assess and plan
- Lead discovery workshops with marketing, campaign operations, data, architecture, security, mobile, and IT stakeholders.
- Inventory the Campaign estate: use cases (batch, scheduled, transactional, event-triggered, real-time); assets (campaigns, workflows, audiences, deliveries, templates, content blocks, personalization, typologies, suppression rules, reporting); data (schemas and extensions, custom resources, relational data, targeting dimensions, identifiers, consent, opt-out, quarantine, bounce, engagement history); and infrastructure (on-premises or Managed Services hosting, network access, firewalls, file transfer, decommissioning needs).
- Reverse-engineer custom logic and document the business rules: technical and marketing workflows (query, enrichment, split, deduplication, reconciliation, update data, JavaScript code activities), custom JavaScript, JSSP, SOAP/JS API calls, SQL functions, stored procedures, custom relational structures, typology rules, input forms, web applications, landing pages, subscriptions, Message Center, Triggers/pipeline, offer logic, external accounts, APIs, middleware, and enterprise integrations.
- Map each use case and dependency to an AJO/AEP target pattern and classify it as reuse, redesign, rebuild, integrate, defer, or retain elsewhere. For custom logic, decide whether to re-express it in AEP/AJO (data model, Query Service, custom actions, external services), redesign or rebuild it separately, or retain it in Campaign.
- Choose the execution path per use case based on the target customer experience, not the shape of the source Campaign workflow. Use AJO Journeys when each profile should progress individually based on behaviour, events, or elapsed time, including many scheduled and recurring Campaign workflows rebuilt as Read Audience or business-event journeys. Use Orchestrated Campaigns for relational or multi-entity data, complex audience construction and enrichment, exact pre-send counts, and multi-level sending. Use action campaigns for simple scheduled or API-triggered sends. Document the rationale, combined patterns, and license prerequisites (e.g., the Journey Optimizer Campaigns package).
- Surface product-fit gaps and operational impacts before committing to scope or feature-parity claims. Advise when Campaign coexistence or another path fits better: Campaign v8 for ACC customers, or the ACS-to-Campaign v8 transition for ACS customers.
- Develop phased roadmaps, effort estimates, dependency plans, risks, and customer decision points.
- Architect and implement
- Design the AEP foundation: XDM schemas and field groups (profile, event, lookup); identity namespaces, identity resolution, profile enablement, and data relationships; datasets, sources, destinations, batch and streaming ingestion, and event design; data quality and governance; audience qualification and segmentation; and Query Service or other processing for transformation, aggregation, and enrichment.
- Replace common Campaign data patterns with AEP capabilities: Federated Audience Composition on Snowflake, Google BigQuery, Databricks, or other warehouses (closest to ACC Federated Data Access); computed attributes for profile-level aggregates; Data Distiller for scheduled SQL transformations; merge policies; and profile and segmentation guardrails.
- Design customer experiences and build AJO journeys and campaigns across batch and event-driven engagement: event- and segment-triggered orchestration, conditions, actions, custom actions, message content, personalization, and decisioning.
- Apply journey and campaign governance and optimization: business rules, frequency capping, quiet hours, journey priority and arbitration, conflict management, wave sending, content experimentation, and decisioning policies and rankings.
- Define security, access, permissions, governance, and operational controls.
- Build channels, integrations, and extensibility
- Configure AJO channels end to end: email, mobile and web push, in-app, web, code-based experiences, content cards, inbox, live activities, SMS/MMS, RCS, WhatsApp, LINE, and direct mail. Cover channel configurations, subdomains, API credentials, feedback webhooks, mobile app and SDK dependencies, channel-specific data and consent requirements, and template approval rules (e.g., WhatsApp/Meta).
- Connect messaging providers: native SMS providers (Sinch, Twilio, Infobip); bring-your-own-provider (BYOP) setups with provider payloads, inbound keyword handling, delivery receipts, and opt-in/opt-out webhooks and flows; and Channel Builder custom channels for non-native platforms or customer-owned gateways (e.g., regional or industry-specific providers), covering endpoint, authentication, throttling, payload structure, and monitoring.
- Design and build integrations using supported APIs, source connectors, file exchange, middleware, or Adobe solution integrations, including custom actions that call external systems from journeys (CRM, loyalty, order, recommendation, call-center, notification services) with request/response schemas, authentication (OAuth 2.0, API keys, mTLS), capping, throttling, retries, and error handling.
- Implement event and API-triggered patterns: unitary and business events, API-triggered and transactional campaigns, Interactive Message Execution / Journey and Campaign APIs, and streaming ingestion via HTTP API.
- Design and build Journeys (profile-centric)
- Select and configure the journey entry pattern per use case: unitary-event journeys for behavioural and transactional signals; audience qualification journeys on streaming audiences for real-time lifecycle moments; Read Audience journeys, one-shot or recurring with incremental read, for scheduled and batch-initiated programs that previously ran as recurring Campaign workflows; and business-event journeys that release an audience when an operational event occurs (e.g., a price drop or flight delay). Configure identity namespaces, reentrance and wait periods, exit criteria, and time zones.
- Build multi-step journeys where each customer progresses at their own pace: Wait activities; the Optimize activity for conditions, path targeting, and path experiments; reaction events on opens and clicks with timeout paths; Update Profile; Content Decision for offers; external data sources and custom actions for real-time lookups and system writebacks; and Jump activities to split complex programs into reusable journeys.
- Use supplemental identifiers (e.g., order, booking, subscription, or policy IDs), where enabled, to run one journey instance per entity and personalize with its attributes. Decide when per-entity use cases fit journeys versus orchestrated campaign multi-level sending.
- Support phased migration and coexistence from the journey canvas, including Adobe Campaign v7/v8 and ACS actions that let AJO orchestrate while Campaign transactional messaging delivers, until channels and content move to native AJO.
- Design within journey guardrails (one active instance per profile per journey, one Read Audience per journey and concurrent-run limits, entrance and processing throughput per sandbox, Jump and supplemental identifier restrictions, reaction event placement, custom action capping, and versioning impact on live profiles). Flag gaps to the customer early.
- Design and build Orchestrated Campaigns (relational)
- Design the data model with AEP relational (model-based) schemas, built manually or from a DDL or Excel upload: tables, primary and composite keys, version descriptors (e.g., lastmodified), ENUMs, data governance labels, identity fields mapped to identity namespaces, and links with correct cardinality (1-N, N-1, 1-1) to recipient and profile entities.
- Configure target dimensions, including the profile target dimension linking XDM profile and experience event data to relational data; decide what belongs in the profile store versus relational tables to avoid duplication.
- Set up Change Data Capture (CDC) ingestion from supported sources (e.g., Amazon S3, Google Cloud Storage, SFTP, Snowflake, Google BigQuery, Azure Databricks, Data Landing Zone): the \_change\_request\_type field for file-based loads, table logging for cloud warehouses, complete-record loads, deletion handling, and latency planning.
- Build multi-step canvases with targeting, flow control, and channel activities (Build, Read, and Save audience, Enrichment, Change dimension, Combine, Deduplication, Reconciliation, Split, Fork, AND-join, Wait, Alert), including multi-entity segmentation and multi-level sending (e.g., one message per booking, contract, subscription, account, or address linked to a profile) personalized with enriched relational attributes. Configure scheduling, recurring runs, and pre-send count validation.
- Design within orchestrated campaign guardrails (table count and schema size limits, daily change-volume limits, scalar-only audience attributes, uncached audience evaluation, permanent dataset table names, channel availability by license). Flag gaps to the customer early.
- Migrate data, logic, and personalization
- Translate the ACC/ACS relational data model to AEP: map recipient, custom, and relational tables to XDM profile, experience event, and lookup schemas, or to relational schemas for orchestrated campaigns; define primary and secondary identities, relationships, cardinality, and denormalization trade-offs.
- Migrate historical and operational data (profile attributes, subscriptions, consent and opt-out status, quarantine and bounce history, engagement data) via batch backfill, delta loads, and reconciliation reports. Map ACC/ACS denylist and subscription data to the AEP Consent and Preferences field group and AJO subscription lists; load quarantined and bounced addresses into the AJO suppression list via the Suppression API so blocked recipients stay blocked from day one.
- Rebuild Campaign workflow logic according to the chosen path. For journeys, express targeting as AEP audiences (batch, streaming, or edge) and computed attributes, recurring workflows as scheduled Read Audience journeys, and waits, splits, and tests as Wait and Optimize activities. For orchestrated campaigns, rebuild queries, enrichments, splits, union/intersection/exclusion, deduplication, change dimension, and reconciliation as canvas activities. Use Query Service (SQL/CTAS) jobs or source dataflows for scheduled imports/exports and data preparation. Move logic neither canvas supports (JavaScript activities and code, SQL code, loops, file manipulation) to the source system, Query Service or Data Distiller, or external services.
- Re-architect lifecycle programs (welcome, onboarding, renewal, win-back, abandonment) built in Campaign as chained or recurring workflows into journeys, replacing workflow-based state tracking (custom flags, prior-recipient exclusion lists, wait loops) with journey state, reentrance rules, and exit criteria.
Convert ACC/ACS HTML content, templates, and personalization ( scripting, JavaScript in content, personalization blocks, conditional content) to AJO content templates and Handlebars/PQL: helper functions, conditional and dynamic content, expression and visual fragments, and decisioning outputs. Validate matching output with seed and test profiles.- Map Message Center, Triggers/pipeline, and other transactional or signal-driven flows to AJO unitary-event journeys or API-triggered campaigns, and typology, pressure, and fatigue rules to AJO business rules, frequency capping, suppression rules, and quiet hours.
- Migrate ACC Interaction offer logic (catalogs, categories, eligibility rules, weights, typology and presentation rules, inbound and outbound environments) to AJO Decisioning: decision items,
collections, selection strategies, ranking formulas or AI models, and capping. Confirm whether the customer is licensed for Decisioning or legacy Offer Decisioning.
  
  

* Rebuild Campaign landing pages, subscription and preference centers, web and survey forms, ACC web applications, and JSSP pages as AJO landing pages, subscription lists, or customer-owned web front ends connected through AEP APIs, writing consent and preferences back to AEP.
* Deliver, test, and transition
* Establish development, test/stage, and production delivery practices with Git version control and a sandbox strategy. Support controlled promotion and release management with AEP sandbox tooling packages (schemas, audiences, journeys, content templates), journey versioning, simulation, and dry-run checks before publishing.
* Build requirements-traceable test strategies and plans covering data and identity validation, audience counts, journey logic, personalization, rendering, API behavior, consent, suppression, channel delivery, and reporting.
* Design dual-run and cutover plans, synchronizing and reconciling consent, opt-outs, quarantine, bounces, profile data, and engagement history as needed.
* Plan deliverability readiness and email domain migration: subdomain delegation (full or CNAME), SPF, DKIM, DMARC, BIMI, one-click List-Unsubscribe headers, Gmail/Yahoo bulk-sender requirements, IP pools and strategy, ramp-up and warm-up, bounce, quarantine, suppression, and opt-in/opt-out handling, and operational monitoring and reporting.
* Rebuild Campaign reporting and tracking with AJO built-in journey and campaign reports, Customer Journey Analytics where licensed, and Query Service on AJO system datasets (message feedback, email tracking, journey step events). Agree with the customer which ACC reports, KPIs, and tracking logs need equivalents.
* Define measurable launch and migration acceptance criteria; support business validation, production readiness, go-live, stabilization, and continuous improvement.
* Hand over with implementation documentation, architecture diagrams, reproducible data mapping specifications, runbooks, testing evidence, and operational and support materials; coach customer teams on the AJO operating model, AEP concepts, changed workflows, new responsibilities, and adoption needs.

What we want from you
  
  

* Adobe Campaign Classic - ACC v7/v8 architecture and implementation, including mid-sourcing, FFDA/Snowflake on v8, and Federated Data Access. * Adobe Experience Platform - XDM modeling; schemas, datasets, identity namespaces and identity resolution; Real-Time Customer Profile concepts; batch and streaming ingestion; sources and destinations; segmentation; Query Service/data transformation; governance and consent considerations; sandboxes and environment strategy.
* Adobe Journey Optimizer - Journey and campaign design (action, API-triggered, orchestrated); unitary, business, and audience-based patterns; journey activities, conditions

What we can offer you
  
  
Alongside the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting brands around the world, we’ll also prioritise your career development and help you grow your skills. We’ll empower you to make a difference, allow you to be yourself, and respect who you are.
  
  
Our culture thrives on our core values, designed for impact-driven individuals: Heart, Brains and Courage.
  
  
We lead with
**Heart**
, fostering empathy and trust where genuine connections and human-centric work flourish.
  
  
We empower your
**Brains**
for innovation, valuing relentless curiosity and collaborative intelligence to solve complex challenges.
  
  
And we champion
**Courage**
, inspiring you to speak up, embrace experimentation, and advocate for bold solutions that push our thinking to be better than yesterday.

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence and world-class partnerships – all united by our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. title: AI Lead - Agentic
description:
**Job Requirements**
Act as a Business Partner to develop embedded Agentic Business Processes and Identify, Design & Deliver AI Agents that create measurable Business Value. The incumbent will partner with Business teams to convert operational challenges into intelligent Agentic AI solutions, decision intelligence and natural language interaction with enterprise data.
  
  

* The role will drive Jakson Group's Agentic AI journey by combining business process understanding with modern Microsoft AI technologies including Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Fabric and Power BI.
* Architect, build, deploy and maintain enterprise agents using Azure AI Foundry & Python. Define agent workflows, orchestration logic, business rules and exception handling.
* Lead end-to-end Agent Development Life Cycle (ADLC) comprising use-case identification, functional requirement documentation, agent design & technical specifications, agent development, quality assurance, user acceptance and continuous improvement & support.
* Own Documentation and adherence to change control policies & procedures.
* Conduct workshops with business stakeholders to identify agentic opportunities and translate business use case into measurable success criteria for agentic initiatives. Prioritise use cases based on business impact, feasibility, data readiness and strategic alignment.
* Act as a strategic link between business stakeholders, shared IT COEs and agentic solution partners to facilitate development & deployment of LLM-based AI agents.
* Implement agents with appropriate information security, governance and compliance controls. Develop & ensure compliance with Data & AI policies, standard operating procedures and data governance. Ensure timely upgrades of landscape to latest standards.
* Conduct workshops, demonstrations, training sessions for adoption and realised business benefits.
* Collaborate with Data & AI team for solution architecture, data quality & readiness and agent development.
* Organize scheduled progress reviews and track deliveries as per agreed timelines & cost and provide updates to business stakeholders.
* Manage relationships with Data & AI vendors and periodically review SLA adherence & delivery quality.
* Own uptime, integrity, performance, security and support SLA adherence of AI technology landscape.
* Stay updated with the latest AI technologies and industry trends to drive continuous improvement.

**Work Experience**
**Technical & Functional Skills:**
B.E. / B. Tech (Computer Science / Data Science or a related field)
  
  

* 12+years of experience in Data Science & Analytics with minimum 3 years in a lead role for agent development.
* Deep hands-on experience with Azure AI Foundry, LLM integrations, and Python programming for data engineering and machine learning.
* Knowledge of Power BI & Microsoft Fabric including OneLake, Data Factory & Synapse.
* Deployed at least one AI agent from conceptualization to design to delivery in a large enterprise.
* Experience working with business stakeholders across multiple functions.

- Select and configure the journey entry pattern per use case: unitary-event journeys for behavioural and transactional signals; audience qualification journeys on streaming audiences for real-time lifecycle moments; Read Audience journeys, one-shot or recurring with incremental read, for scheduled and batch-initiated programs that previously ran as recurring Campaign workflows; and business-event journeys that release an audience when an operational event occurs (e.g., a price drop or flight delay). Configure identity namespaces, reentrance and wait periods, exit criteria, and time zones.
- Build multi-step journeys where each customer progresses at their own pace: Wait activities; the Optimize activity for conditions, path targeting, and path experiments; reaction events on opens and clicks with timeout paths; Update Profile; Content Decision for offers; external data sources and custom actions for real-time lookups and system writebacks; and Jump activities to split complex programs into reusable journeys.
- Use supplemental identifiers (e.g., order, booking, subscription, or policy IDs), where enabled, to run one journey instance per entity and personalize with its attributes. Decide when per-entity use cases fit journeys versus orchestrated campaign multi-level sending.
- Support phased migration and coexistence from the journey canvas, including Adobe Campaign v7/v8 and ACS actions that let AJO orchestrate while Campaign transactional messaging delivers, until channels and content move to native AJO.
- Design within journey guardrails (one active instance per profile per journey, one Read Audience per journey and concurrent-run limits, entrance and processing throughput per sandbox, Jump and supplemental identifier restrictions, reaction event placement, custom action capping, and versioning impact on live profiles). Flag gaps to the customer early.
- Design and build Orchestrated Campaigns (relational)
- Design the data model with AEP relational (model-based) schemas, built manually or from a DDL or Excel upload: tables, primary and composite keys, version descriptors (e.g., lastmodified), ENUMs, data governance labels, identity fields mapped to identity namespaces, and links with correct cardinality (1-N, N-1, 1-1) to recipient and profile entities.
- Configure target dimensions, including the profile target dimension linking XDM profile and experience event data to relational data; decide what belongs in the profile store versus relational tables to avoid duplication.
- Set up Change Data Capture (CDC) ingestion from supported sources (e.g., Amazon S3, Google Cloud Storage, SFTP, Snowflake, Google BigQuery, Azure Databricks, Data Landing Zone): the \_change\_request\_type field for file-based loads, table logging for cloud warehouses, complete-record loads, deletion handling, and latency planning.
- Build multi-step canvases with targeting, flow control, and channel activities (Build, Read, and Save audience, Enrichment, Change dimension, Combine, Deduplication, Reconciliation, Split, Fork, AND-join, Wait, Alert), including multi-entity segmentation and multi-level sending (e.g., one message per booking, contract, subscription, account, or address linked to a profile) personalized with enriched relational attributes. Configure scheduling, recurring runs, and pre-send count validation.
- Design within orchestrated campaign guardrails (table count and schema size limits, daily change-volume limits, scalar-only audience attributes, uncached audience evaluation, permanent dataset table names, channel availability by license). Flag gaps to the customer early.
- Migrate data, logic, and personalization
- Translate the ACC/ACS relational data model to AEP: map recipient, custom, and relational tables to XDM profile, experience event, and lookup schemas, or to relational schemas for orchestrated campaigns; define primary and secondary identities, relationships, cardinality, and denormalization trade-offs.
- Migrate historical and operational data (profile attributes, subscriptions, consent and opt-out status, quarantine and bounce history, engagement data) via batch backfill, delta loads, and reconciliation reports. Map ACC/ACS denylist and subscription data to the AEP Consent and Preferences field group and AJO subscription lists; load quarantined and bounced addresses into the AJO suppression list via the Suppression API so blocked recipients stay blocked from day one.
- Rebuild Campaign workflow logic according to the chosen path. For journeys, express targeting as AEP audiences (batch, streaming, or edge) and computed attributes, recurring workflows as scheduled Read Audience journeys, and waits, splits, and tests as Wait and Optimize activities. For orchestrated campaigns, rebuild queries, enrichments, splits, union/intersection/exclusion, deduplication, change dimension, and reconciliation as canvas activities. Use Query Service (SQL/CTAS) jobs or source dataflows for scheduled imports/exports and data preparation. Move logic neither canvas supports (JavaScript activities and code, SQL code, loops, file manipulation) to the source system, Query Service or Data Distiller, or external services.
- Re-architect lifecycle programs (welcome, onboarding, renewal, win-back, abandonment) built in Campaign as chained or recurring workflows into journeys, replacing workflow-based state tracking (custom flags, prior-recipient exclusion lists, wait loops) with journey state, reentrance rules, and exit criteria.
Convert ACC/ACS HTML content, templates, and personalization ( scripting, JavaScript in content, personalization blocks, conditional content) to AJO content templates and Handlebars/PQL: helper functions, conditional and dynamic content, expression and visual fragments, and decisioning outputs. Validate matching output with seed and test profiles.- Map Message Center, Triggers/pipeline, and other transactional or signal-driven flows to AJO unitary-event journeys or API-triggered campaigns, and typology, pressure, and fatigue rules to AJO business rules, frequency capping, suppression rules, and quiet hours.
- Migrate ACC Interaction offer logic (catalogs, categories, eligibility rules, weights, typology and presentation rules, inbound and outbound environments) to AJO Decisioning: decision items,
collections, selection strategies, ranking formulas or AI models, and capping. Confirm whether the customer is licensed for Decisioning or legacy Offer Decisioning.
  
  

* Rebuild Campaign landing pages, subscription and preference centers, web and survey forms, ACC web applications, and JSSP pages as AJO landing pages, subscription lists, or customer-owned web front ends connected through AEP APIs, writing consent and preferences back to AEP.
* Deliver, test, and transition
* Establish development, test/stage, and production delivery practices with Git version control and a sandbox strategy. Support controlled promotion and release management with AEP sandbox tooling packages (schemas, audiences, journeys, content templates), journey versioning, simulation, and dry-run checks before publishing.
* Build requirements-traceable test strategies and plans covering data and identity validation, audience counts, journey logic, personalization, rendering, API behavior, consent, suppression, channel delivery, and reporting.
* Design dual-run and cutover plans, synchronizing and reconciling consent, opt-outs, quarantine, bounces, profile data, and engagement history as needed.
* Plan deliverability readiness and email domain migration: subdomain delegation (full or CNAME), SPF, DKIM, DMARC, BIMI, one-click List-Unsubscribe headers, Gmail/Yahoo bulk-sender requirements, IP pools and strategy, ramp-up and warm-up, bounce, quarantine, suppression, and opt-in/opt-out handling, and operational monitoring and reporting.
* Rebuild Campaign reporting and tracking with AJO built-in journey and campaign reports, Customer Journey Analytics where licensed, and Query Service on AJO system datasets (message feedback, email tracking, journey step events). Agree with the customer which ACC reports, KPIs, and tracking logs need equivalents.
* Define measurable launch and migration acceptance criteria; support business validation, production readiness, go-live, stabilization, and continuous improvement.
* Hand over with implementation documentation, architecture diagrams, reproducible data mapping specifications, runbooks, testing evidence, and operational and support materials; coach customer teams on the AJO operating model, AEP concepts, changed workflows, new responsibilities, and adoption needs.

What we want from you
  
  

* Adobe Campaign Classic - ACC v7/v8 architecture and implementation, including mid-sourcing, FFDA/Snowflake on v8, and Federated Data Access. Campaign data model and XML schema extensions; workflows and technical workflows; targeting and enrichment; deliveries, templates, personalization, typologies, and rules; transactional messaging (Message Center) and Triggers where applicable; tracking and delivery data; JSSP, web applications, SOAP APIs, packages, and external accounts; customizations and integrations.
* Adobe Campaign Standard - ACS campaign and workflow design; audiences, deliveries, templates, personalization, channel configuration, data resources, imports/exports, APIs, and consent and subscription practices. Assessing ACS implementations and translating requirements to AEP/AJO design.
* Adobe Experience Platform - XDM modeling; schemas, datasets, identity namespaces and identity resolution; Real-Time Customer Profile concepts; batch and streaming ingestion; sources and destinations; segmentation; Query Service/data transformation; governance and consent considerations; sandboxes and environment strategy.
* Adobe Journey Optimizer - Journey and campaign design (action, API-triggered, orchestrated); unitary, business, and audience-based patterns; journey activities, conditions

What we can offer you
  
  
Alongside the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting brands around the world, we’ll also prioritise your career development and help you grow your skills. We’ll empower you to make a difference, allow you to be yourself, and respect who you are.
  
  
Our culture thrives on our core values, designed for impact-driven individuals: Heart, Brains and Courage.
  
  
We lead with
**Heart**
, fostering empathy and trust where genuine connections and human-centric work flourish.
  
  
We empower your
**Brains**
for innovation, valuing relentless curiosity and collaborative intelligence to solve complex challenges.
  
  
And we champion
**Courage**
, inspiring you to speak up, embrace experimentation, and advocate for bold solutions that push our thinking to be better than yesterday.

title: Data Solutions Architect 3rd
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**
At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
  
  
**Job Description:**
A career in our Business Intelligence practice, within Data and Analytics Technology services, will provide you with the opportunity to help organizations uncover enterprise insights and drive business results using smarter data analytics. Leveraging a collection of organizational technology capabilities, including business intelligence, data management, and data assurance, we help our clients drive innovation, growth, and change within their organization using business intelligence.
  
  
Our rapid business intelligence solutions, data visualization, and integrated reporting dashboards allow our team to deliver agile, highly interactive reporting and analytics that help our clients to run their business, understand what business questions can be answered and how to unlock the business drivers more effectively.
  
  
**Specific responsibilities include but are not limited to:**
Crowe is looking for a Data Solutions Architect to be a leader on our team of problem solvers with extensive consulting and industry experience. The primary focus will be helping our clients solve complex business issues from strategy to execution. Specific responsibilities include but are not limited to:
  
  

* The shift timings for this role is 5:00PM - 2:00AM IST (7:30AM - 4:30PM ET)
* Serve as subject matter expert on Business Intelligence engineering platforms (Ex - Microsoft SQL Server, Azure Data platform, Snowflake, DBT) demonstrating platform capabilities and promoting application of toolset to address business needs and maximize the value realized from technology investment.
* Oversee the design and deployment of data pipelines, analytics platforms, and reporting frameworks that improve transparency and support decision-making.
* Utilize advanced analytics, machine learning, and statistical modeling techniques to detect anomalous activity and patterns in transaction data.
* Ensure data quality and integrity through best practices in data management and governance.
* Mentor and lead a team of data analysts and consultants, fostering a collaborative and innovative work environment.

* Architect, implement, deploy, and support analytical databases and pipelines in an Azure environment
* Create proofs of concepts as necessary for architectural vision, strategy, and tool evaluation.
* Document, diagram, and present complex/technical material that can be understood by a non-technical audience.
* Create and deploy accurate client architecture and analyses in a relatively short period of time.

**Qualifications**

* Advanced degree (Master’s/Ph.D.) is preferred.
* At least 7–10 years of progressive experience in data analytics, consulting, or financial services; a strong background in banking and regulatory compliance implementations is desired.
* Proven track record in managing complex data projects and leading cross-functional teams.
* Experience in working with large datasets, data warehousing, and advanced analytics tools.
* 8+ years of hands-on experience in enterprise data warehouse and data lake implementations
* 5+ years of external client consulting experience
* 5+ years of hands-on experience building automated ETL/ELT or data integration processes utilizing multiple source systems
* 5+ years of team management experience (including offshore resources)
* 5+ years of experience leading multiple external client projects simultaneously
* 5+ years of preparing detailed external client project budget estimations with strong resource management capabilities
* 3+ years of in-depth experience in architecting, designing, and implementing complex data architectures on Azure including Azure Data Factory, Azure/Managed Instance SQL Server, Azure Logic App, and Azure Synapse Analytics
* Experience mentoring teammates or conducting technical training
* Possess integrity and a strong work ethic
* Strong analytical and verbal/written communication skills

**Certifications (Preferred):**

* Certifications in BI (ETL tools, visualization tools, cloud architectures) are expected
* Certifications such as CAMS (Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist), CFE (Certified Fraud Examiner), or related data analytics certifications are a plus.

**Preferred Skills and Experience:**

* Experience working in or consulting for financial services clients is highly desirable.
* Hands-on experience with comprehensive dimensional modelling and end-to-end data warehouse projects, including:

+ Requirements gathering
+ Infrastructure planning and deployment
+ Subject matter expert interviews
+ Logical and physical dimensional model design and development
+ ETL/ELT development and maintenance model and data validation
+ Documentation

* Previous consulting experience or experience working with external clients
* Proficiency in analytics and statistical programming languages (e.g., Python, R, SQL).
* Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) and big data technologies.
* Familiarity with machine learning frameworks and cloud-based data platforms is advantageous
* Experience working on projects using agile development practices
* Azure experience: building landing zones, provisioning resources, establishing security is a big plus

**Key Stakeholders This Role Interacts With:**
**Internal**

* Senior BI Analyst
* Data Product Manager
* BI Architect / Senior Architect
* Data Engineers
* Analytics Developers (Power BI, Tableau)

**External**

* C-Suite Executives (CEO, CFO, CIO, etc.)
* Clients Operations Leads and Mid-Level Managers
* Data Owners, Data Stewards
* Enterprise Information Management and Data Governance Team

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

title: AWS Data Engineer - Data Platform
description:
**Who We Are**
Zinnia is the leading technology platform for accelerating life and annuities growth. With innovative enterprise solutions and data insights, Zinnia simplifies the experience of buying, selling, and administering insurance products. All of which enables more people to protect their financial futures. Our success is driven by a commitment to three core values: be bold, team up, deliver value – and that we do. Zinnia has over $180 billion in assets under administration, serves 100+ carrier clients, 2500 distributors and partners, and over 2 million policyholders.
  
  
**Who You Are**
You are a
**Data Engineer who wants to go deep on platform and infrastructure work**
— building the pipelines, storage, and platform foundations that the rest of the business builds on. You think in terms of well-modeled data, reliable orchestration, and infrastructure that holds up under real production load.
  
  
**You are good with SQL and Python, know your way around AWS core services**
, and can take a clear set of requirements and turn them into solid, well-tested outcomes. You are curious about how data platforms can be setup, scaled, integrated in the wider application ecosystem and resulting data feeds downstream analytics and machine learning use cases.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Build and maintain scalable, reliable data platforms and pipelines that power analytics and data-driven products across Zinnia.
* Work within the data platform's AWS infrastructure — storage, IAM, compute and orchestration services — implementing and tuning components under the guidance of senior engineers.
* Implement and integrate with telemetry and observability solutions for Infrastructure and Platform reliability.
* Provision and modify data infrastructure components (S3 buckets, IAM roles, Lambda, RDS/Aurora, compute resources) using Terraform, including Snowflake infrastructure-as-code (warehouses, roles, databases), working from existing modules and patterns.
* Familiarity with streaming or event-driven data (Kafka, Kinesis, or similar)
* Package, deploy, and manage pipeline components as containerized services (ex: Docker, Kubernetes/EKS, ECS), including EKS cluster upgrades and configuration changes
* Implement data quality checks, monitoring, and basic lineage so downstream teams can trust the data they're consuming.
* Contribute to data governance, access control, and cost-optimization practices within AWS and Snowflake.
* Troubleshoot pipeline and infrastructure issues, escalating and collaborating with senior engineers on complex or systemic problems.
* Write clear documentation and follow established technical standards for the data platform.
* Develop and maintain ELT/ETL workflows using Airflow, dbt, and Airbyte (or similar ingestion tools) for self-serve data access
* Familiarity with AI-assisted engineering tools and platforms (e.g., Claude, Cortex Code), LLM-based workflows, and agentic automation to support infrastructure and platform changes

**What You’ll Need**

* 4+ years of experience in Data Platform Engineering
* Hands-on experience with AWS core services (e.g., S3, IAM, compute services)
* Good hands-on proficiency in SQL and Python for data transformation and pipeline development.
* Experience with a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake or similar.
* Working knowledge of Airflow for orchestration and scheduling, including managed Airflow (MWAA) or similar hosted-Airflow configuration and environment management.
* Experience/awareness with dbt, including dbt Cloud, for transformations, testing, documentation, and job/environment configuration.
* Solid understanding of data modeling fundamentals (dimensional and fact-based designs).
* Comfort working in agile, cross-functional teams alongside more senior engineers, analysts, and data scientists.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills.

**Nice to have:**

* Exposure to MLOps concepts — training data pipelines, feature generation, or model monitoring data.
* Experience with Airbyte or similar ELT ingestion tools.
* Familiarity with CI/CD practices for data pipelines, including building and maintaining GitHub repositories and GitHub Actions pipelines.
* Experience in a regulated industry such as insurance or financial services.

**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?**
At Zinnia, you collaborate with smart, creative professionals who are dedicated to delivering cutting-edge technologies, deeper data insights, and enhanced services to transform how insurance is done. Visit our website at www.zinnia.com for more information. Apply by completing the online application on the careers section of our website. We are an Equal Opportunity employer committed to a diverse workforce. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability.

title: Engineer - AI (Mining Automation)
description:
**Job Description**
WSP is seeking an Engineer AI (Mining Automation) to join the GCC Specialist Mining Services team, supporting the delivery of digital and automation solutions for global mining projects. Reporting to the Mining Automation Team Leader, the successful candidate will develop and implement AI-enabled workflows that improve the way mining, asset, operational, geotechnical, and technical information is processed, connected, analysed, and used for engineering decision-making.
  
  
The role combines mining-domain understanding with artificial intelligence, automation, data engineering, computer vision, knowledge extraction, and graph-based retrieval. The Engineer will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across WSP to develop practical, scalable, traceable, and responsible solutions for mine planning, operations, tailings and water management, asset performance, risk management, and engineering delivery.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**AI and Mining Automation Development**

* Design, develop, and implement AI-enabled automation solutions for mining engineering and operational workflows.
* Work with mining specialists to identify high-value automation opportunities and convert technical requirements into practical digital solutions.
* Develop intelligent workflows that integrate geological, geotechnical, mine planning, operational, asset,

environmental, and risk information.
  
  

* Support the use of generative AI, machine learning, computer vision, and agent-based approaches to improve engineering productivity and decision support.
* Create reusable components and scalable solution patterns that can be applied across global mining projects.

**Data Extraction and Document Intelligence**

* Develop automated pipelines to extract information from mining reports, PDFs, scanned documents, drawings, tables, figures, inspection records, and monitoring outputs.
* Apply OCR, layout understanding, multimodal models, and LLM-based techniques to identify entities, attributes, relationships, measurements, risks, and supporting evidence.
* Implement validation, normalization, exception-handling, and quality-control logic to improve the accuracy and consistency of extracted information.
* Maintain traceability between extracted outputs and the relevant source documents, pages, figures, tables, or evidence.

**AI Models and Advanced Analytics**

* Develop, validate, and support deployment of machine learning solutions for predictive analytics, anomaly detection, classification, risk assessment, optimization, and asset insights.
* Apply data science and statistical methods to identify patterns, trends, and actionable insights from engineering and operational data.
* Evaluate model performance, limitations, and suitability for mining use cases, working with domain experts to confirm engineering relevance.
* Contribute to proof-of-concept development and the transition of successful prototypes into maintainable production solutions.

**Knowledge Management and Graph-Based Intelligence**

* Support the design of structured knowledge models that connect mining assets, technical information, operational data, risks, controls, and engineering evidence.
* Contribute to knowledge graph and semantic data solutions using RDF, OWL, SPARQL, or equivalent technologies where appropriate.
* Develop graph-native and hybrid retrieval workflows, including GraphRAG approaches that combine structured graph context with AI models.
* Enable natural-language access to connected mining knowledge for engineering assistants, analytics tools, and decision-support applications.
* Support provenance, versioning, evidence linking, and auditability of AI-generated or graph-derived outputs.

**Cloud, Data, and Platform Integration**

* Develop and integrate solutions using Azure AI services, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI

Document Intelligence, and related cloud capabilities, where applicable.
  
  

* Build and maintain data pipelines, APIs, connectors, and services that integrate AI workflows with engineering platforms and enterprise data environments.
* Contribute to deployment, monitoring, documentation, testing, and continuous improvement of production AI applications.
* Support MLOps, prompt and model evaluation, access control, data security, and responsible AI practices.

**Global Project Delivery and Collaboration**

* Work as part of the GCC Specialist Mining Services team to support multidisciplinary mining assignments delivered across WSP's global business.
* Collaborate with the Mining Automation Team Leader, mining engineers, geotechnical specialists, tailings

practitioners, data scientists, software developers, and digital teams.
  
  

* Engage with project and domain teams to understand technical context, refine use cases, review outputs, and align solutions with project requirements.
* Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders across different regions and time zones.
* Prepare solution documentation, specifications, test records, user guidance, and knowledge-transfer materials.
* Contribute to internal standards, reusable assets, lessons learned, innovation initiatives, and capability

development within the team.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mining Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence,

Software Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, or a related discipline.
  
  
**Technical Experience And Skills**

* Experience developing AI, machine learning, automation, data analytics, or document intelligence solutions in

mining, engineering, infrastructure, industrial, or asset-intensive environments.
  
  

* Proficiency in Python and experience with relevant AI, data science, or machine learning libraries and frameworks.
* Hands-on experience with large language models, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, or generative AI application development.
* Knowledge of data engineering concepts, ETL or ELT pipelines, APIs, structured and unstructured data processing, and system integration.
* Experience with OCR, document processing, computer vision, layout analysis, or multimodal AI techniques.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Azure-based AI and data services.

title: Sr Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
At Adobe, you will be immersed in an exceptional work environment that is recognized around the world. Adobe is listed as Fortune’s “100 Best Companies to Work For” for 20 consecutive years. Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We give global brands everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences. We’re passionate about transforming how companies interact with customers across every screen.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
Adobe Experience Platform and Apps powers real-time customer experiences for the world’s largest enterprises — unifying data, resolving identity at scale, orchestrating journeys, and activating audiences across channels.
  
  
The Forward Deployed Engineer sits at the intersection of solution architecture, technical consulting, and hands-on engineering. You’ll work directly with Adobe’s strategic customers to solve complex platform challenges, design scalable architectures, and build solutions that accelerate adoption.
  
  
You’ll operate in a multi-functional Customer Pod with end-to-end ownership, partnering with customers, product teams, and engineers to turn complex problems into working solutions.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Partner with strategic customers to understand their architecture, workflows, security requirements, and business objectives.
* Translate complex customer problems into scalable solution designs, reference architectures, and working prototypes.
* Investigate and resolve production-level platform issues across data ingestion, identity resolution, journey orchestration, and audience activation.
* Design and validate enterprise solutions spanning AEP, AJO, Marketo, and adjacent Adobe systems.
* Lead architecture workshops, health checks, and technical deep-dives that build customer trust.
* Prototype, experiment, and iterate rapidly, using AI-assisted tools as part of your everyday workflow.
* Connect customer needs with product and engineering teams, bringing field insights back into the product roadmap.
* Own the technical relationship with assigned accounts from discovery through implementation, launch, and expansion.

What Success Looks Like
  
  
We hire for demonstrated impact and experience. You’ll bring a combination of technical depth, customer empathy, and collaborative problem solving.
  
  

* Hands-on engineering: You write code, build prototypes, and ship working software. Your architecture decisions are grounded in implementation experience.
* Customer empathy: You understand customers’ goals, constraints, and definitions of success and build trusted relationships through empathy and technical expertise.
* Collaboration and communication: You work effectively with engineers, architects, product managers, and leaders and communicate complex concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Enterprise architecture: You design end-to-end solutions across products and systems, considering integration, scale, security, and production requirements.
* Data expertise: You understand how data is structured, modeled, and moved and can evaluate trade-offs in schema design, identity resolution, and data pipelines.
* AI fluency and continuous learning: You embrace AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent to design, prototype, and deliver solutions.
* Proactive problem solving: You identify emerging challenges and take initiative to move them toward resolution.

What You Need to Succeed
  
  

* 10+ years of experience across solution architecture, software engineering, technical consulting, or customer-facing engineering.
* Bachelor’s or advanced degree in computer science or a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience with CDP, MDM, martech, or data platforms.
* Experience with data governance, privacy-preserving computation, or secure data collaboration.
* Familiarity with identity resolution or customer data unification.
* Experience with workflow orchestration technologies such as Temporal, Step Functions, or similar.
* Experience contributing to architecture decisions or technical strategy at the team or organizational level.
* Experience with Adobe Experience Cloud products such as AEP, AJO, Marketo, CJA, or Target is helpful.
* Experience working in regulated industries such as Financial Services, Healthcare, or Government is also helpful.

Why This Team
  
  
You’ll solve complex enterprise problems with direct customer impact and see your solutions reach production. You’ll combine architecture, engineering, strategy, and customer engagement while working with experienced engineers across Adobe’s global platform teams.
  
  
You’ll also help shape an engineering engagement model centered on rapid experimentation, customer feedback, and AI-assisted execution.
  
  
Come build the next generation of enterprise customer experiences with us!
  
  
Adobe is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and encourage diversity in the workplace regardless of race, gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or veteran status.
  
  
**About Adobe**
Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.
  
  
Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.
  
  
Let’s Adobe together
  
  
At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.
  
  
Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.
  
  
Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com.
  
  
AI Use Guidelines for Interviews
  
  
Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.

title: Snowflake Engineer
description:
**ole Overview**

The Data Warehouse Engineer serves as the primary technical lead for the Snowflake data warehousing ecosystem. This role is responsible for designing scalable data models, managing Snowflake environments, optimizing performance and cost, enforcing security policies, and supporting analytics and enterprise reporting platforms, including Business Objects (BIC), across the organization. The DW Engineer ensures that Snowflake is stable, secure, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards, and collaborates with Platform Administrators and third‑party vendors to ensure reporting platform uptime and timely escalation of issues impacting reporting availability.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Data Modeling & Architecture**

* Design enterprise‑level Snowflake models including conformed dimensions, fact tables, and semantic views.
* Document ERDs, modeling assumptions, and physical/logical architectures.
* Establish and enforce modeling standards, naming conventions, and performance optimization patterns.

**Transformation & Automation**

* Build advanced SQL transformations across all Snowflake layers.
* Implement automated workflows using Tasks, Streams, procedures, and time‑based orchestration.
* Support schema evolution and large‑scale data integration patterns.

**Environment & Release Management**

* Coordinate Snowflake schema and object deployments via Git or CI/CD pipelines.
* Own release readiness for Snowflake across Dev, Test, and Prod.
* Ensure new models, views, RBAC changes, and stored procedures are validated prior to promotion.

**Performance Optimization**

* Conduct performance tuning through micro‑partition analysis, clustering, query plan reviews, and caching strategies.
* Implement Resource Monitors, usage alerts, and proactive performance dashboards.
* Review warehouse utilization to ensure compute resources are right‑sized and cost‑optimized.

**Security, RBAC & Controls**

* Design and maintain Snowflake role hierarchies, object privileges, row‑level security, and masking policies.
* Support audit requests, compliance checks, and evidence gathering for reviews.
* Govern secure internal and external data sharing.

**Cost Management**

* Produce recurring consumption reports to support conduct cost optimization analysis.
* Recommend improvements in warehouse sizing, retention policies, storage optimization, and compute scheduling.

**Cross‑Functional Collaboration**

* Work with Data Engineers to coordinate ingestion design, transformation logic, and schema updates.
* Partner with BI teams to optimize datasets for Power BI, Qlik, and analytical tools.
* Align with Platform Administrators on environment setup, migrations, and operational readiness.

**Documentation & Governance**

* Maintain transformation specifications, lineage, and architectural diagrams.
* Ensure models and pipelines comply with governance policies and development standards.

**Enterprise Operational Reporting Platform (Web Intelligence)**

* Collaborate with Platform Administrators and the vendor to ensure reporting platform uptime and timely escalation of reporting issues.

**Skills & Tools Requirements**

* **Snowflake SQL**
  : 5+ years of advanced SQL development experience, including complex query optimization, data modeling, performance tuning, and ETL/ELT development within Snowflake environments.
* **Snowflake Administration**
  : 3+ years of hands-on experience administering Snowflake platforms, including security, role-based access control (RBAC), warehouse management, monitoring, performance optimization, and cost governance.
* **dbt (Data Build Tool)**
  : 4+ years of experience designing, developing, and maintaining scalable data transformation frameworks using dbt, including testing, documentation, and CI/CD integration.
* **Git / Version Control**
  : 5+ years of experience using Git-based source control systems (GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket) for collaborative development, branching strategies, code reviews, and release management.
* **CI/CD Pipelines & Deployment Automation**
  : 5+ years of experience implementing and supporting CI/CD pipelines for data warehouse and analytics deployments, including automated testing, code promotion, release management, and deployment automation using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or equivalent platforms
* **Financial services experience**
  : Preferred.
* **Business Objects (SAP BO/Web Intelligence)**
  : Preferred.

title: Architect
description:
Area(s) of responsibility
  
  
**BIRLASOFT**
**Job Description**
**Developer / Engineer – Agentic AI (Aisera & Allied Platforms)**
**Experience**
8–12 years
  
  
**Location**
Noida / Pune / Bengaluru / Hyderabad (Hybrid)
  
  
**Practice**
Service Integration Practice
  
  
**Employment Type**
Full-time
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
We are hiring hands-on Developers and Engineers to design, build, and deploy production-grade Agentic AI solutions on Aisera and similar platforms (ServiceNow AI and open agent frameworks) across client engagements. You will develop autonomous and multi-agent systems that reason, plan, and execute — integrating LLMs with enterprise systems to automate ITSM, operations, and business workflows, and remaining hands-on through to delivery.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Develop, configure, and deploy AI agents using Aisera’s platform and comparable agentic AI toolsets to solve real-world client workflows.
* Build autonomous and multi-agent systems capable of planning, reasoning, tool selection, and task execution.
* Design and implement RAG pipelines, function/tool calling, memory and context management, and agent orchestration.
* Integrate agents with external systems — APIs, webhooks, databases, CRMs, ITSM platforms, and data pipelines — for seamless workflow execution.
* Apply prompt engineering and configuration tuning to optimize agent accuracy, latency, and cost in complex enterprise environments.
* Translate business requirements into functional and technical agent designs; run interactive demos and PoCs and iterate on feedback.
* Build scalable backend services/microservices for AI applications; ensure testing, monitoring, and CI/CD best practices.
* Implement AI governance, security, and compliance controls (auth flows, responsible-AI safeguards, observability of agent behavior).
* Troubleshoot, monitor, and continuously improve deployed agents using data-driven evaluation (A/B testing, performance monitoring).

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 8–12 years in software development, AI/ML engineering, or systems integration, with recent hands-on Agentic AI / LLM delivery.
* Hands-on experience with Aisera or comparable agentic AI / conversational AIOps platforms (ServiceNow AI Agents, Automation Anywhere, similar).
* Strong programming in Python (primary), plus Java and/or JavaScript; clean, efficient, production-quality code.
* Proven experience building agents with LLM frameworks — LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or PydanticAI.
* Solid understanding of LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, RAG, function calling, and agent evaluation.
* Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and multi-agent architectures (preferred).
* Integration experience: REST APIs, webhooks, data pipelines; OAuth/OIDC/JWT authorization flows.
* Cloud & DevOps: AWS, Azure, or GCP, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), CI/CD, and monitoring.
* Familiarity with AI/LLM observability tooling (Langfuse, ELK) is highly desirable.
* Strong problem-solving, customer-facing communication, and the ability to work independently.

You understand changes may have effect beyond the immediate change.
